title: Narrative Tenses
summary: الأزمنة التلاتة اللي بنحكي بيها قصة في الماضي: past simple و past continuous و past perfect، وإزاي نستخدمهم في الـ diary.

blocks.text: الدرس ده عن إيه؟

text: **Narrative tenses** are the past tenses we use to tell a story: the **past simple** (main events), the **past continuous** (background and actions in progress) and the **past perfect** (an earlier past).

blocks.text: الدرس ده عن **الأزمنة اللي بنحكي بيها قصة** حصلت في الماضي. أي حكاية محتاجة 3 حاجات: **الأحداث الأساسية** (حصل إيه؟)، **الخلفية** (كان بيحصل إيه حوالينا؟)، و**حاجة حصلت قبلها** (كان حصل إيه قبل كده؟). لكل واحدة زمن.

في الكتاب الدرس ده في **Unit 2: Leisure Time**. الكتاب بيقول في أول الوحدة إنك هتستخدم **the three narrative tenses**، وبيشوفهم في القصة **Not Exactly a Relaxing Day** (رحلة العجل على النيل، صفحة 58-60)، وبعدين بتستخدمهم في كتابة **diary entry** (صفحة 62-63)، وبييجي سؤال عليهم في **Consolidation Review A**.
الفكرة ببساطة: القصة زي فيلم

text: Think of a story as a film. The **past continuous** is the scene in the background. The **past simple** is the action that moves the story forward. The **past perfect** is a flashback to something that happened earlier.

rows: **المشهد في الخلفية**: الكاميرا بتصوّر اللي كان بيحصل.
The sun **was shining** and birds **were singing**.
**الأكشن**: الأحداث اللي بتحرّك القصة واحدة ورا التانية.
We **started** early and **cycled** along the Nile.
I **had never cycled** so far before.

blocks.text: 1) Past Simple: الأحداث الأساسية

text: Form: **verb + -ed** (regular) or the **second form** (irregular). Negative: **didn't + base**. Question: **Did … + base?** Use it for **finished actions** and for **a sequence of events** in the story.

blocks.text: بنستخدمه للأحداث اللي **خلصت**، خصوصًا لما تيجي **ورا بعض بالترتيب**: «صحيت، لبست، ركبت العجلة». ده **العمود الفقري** لأي قصة.

items.en: We **took** short breaks, **drank** water and **continued** moving forward.
items.ar: 3 أحداث ورا بعض بالترتيب ← past simple.

items.en: My friend **insisted** that I join him.

blocks.text: 2) Past Continuous: الخلفية واللي كان بيحصل

text: Form: **was / were + verb-ing**. Use it for (1) the **background** of a scene, (2) an action **in progress** when another action happened, (3) two actions happening **at the same time** (while).

rows: I / he / she / it **was** + ing — you / we / they **were** + ing

blocks.text: بنستخدمه في 3 حالات:

items: **وصف المشهد** في أول القصة: The wind **was blowing** and people **were walking** by the river.
**حدث طويل اتقطع** بحدث قصير: I **was cycling** **when** my phone **rang**. (الطويل continuous، والقصير اللي قطعه past simple)
**حدثين طوال في نفس الوقت** بـ while: **While** I **was struggling**, my friend **was cycling** happily.

blocks.text: الكتاب في جدول الـ diary بيقول: في **الـ turning point** استخدم الـ **Past Continuous** علشان توصف **اللي كان بيحصل حواليك** في اللحظة دي.
3) Past Perfect: الماضي اللي قبل الماضي

text: Form: **had + past participle (V3)** for all subjects. Use it for an action that happened **before** another past action or a past time. Common words: **by the time, before, after, already, just, never… before, when**.

rows: I **hadn't expected** it to be so hard.

blocks.text: لو عندك حدثين في الماضي، والحدث الأول **حصل قبل** التاني، الأقدم ياخد **had + V3**، والأحدث ياخد **past simple**.

items.en: When we finally stopped, I realised we **had cycled** much farther than I **had expected**.
items.ar: الأول: لفّينا مسافة كبيرة وكنت متوقع أقل. بعدين: وقفنا وأدركت. الأقدم had + V3.

items.en: **By the time** we reached the river, the sun **had** already **risen**.
items.ar: by the time + past simple ← الجزء التاني past perfect. الشمس طلعت **قبل** ما نوصل.

items.en: I **had never felt** so exhausted before.
items.ar: never … before = عمري ما حسيت كده قبل كده.

blocks.title: قارن
items: When I arrived, the match **started**. ← وصلت **وبعدين** الماتش بدأ (بدأ وأنا موجود).
When I arrived, the match **had started**. ← الماتش **بدأ قبل** ما أوصل (فاتني الأول).
When I arrived, they **were playing**. ← لما وصلت **كانوا في نص** اللعب.

blocks.text: الكلمات الدالة

text: Time words help you choose the tense, but always check the **meaning** too.

rows: past simple (حدث قصير) + past continuous (طويل) أو past simple + past simple
**By the time** I **got** home, my family **had eaten**.
past perfect للأقدم (أو past simple لو الترتيب واضح)
**After** I **had finished** the trip, I **slept** for ten hours.
خلاص / لسه حالًا / عمري ما… قبل كده

blocks.text: أفعال شاذة لازم تحفظها
في المراجعة فيه سؤال على **had already risen**: لازم تعرف التصريف التالت صح. أشهر الأفعال في القصص:
أمثلة من موضوعات الوحدة
الأمثلة دي عن الهوايات، الرياضة، والخروج في الطبيعة، زي قصة رحلة العجل في الكتاب.

items.en: I **was scrolling** through my phone when my coach **called** me.
items.ar: حدث طويل (كنت بقلّب) اتقطع بحدث قصير (اتصل).

items.en: While the crowd **was cheering**, Malak **was running** the last lap.
items.ar: حدثين طوال في نفس الوقت ← while + past continuous.

items.en: By the time the concert **began**, the musicians **had attended** five rehearsals.
Ziad **had** never **played** the oud before he **joined** the music club.
items.ar: never … before ← past perfect، وبعدها حدث أحدث past simple.

items.en: The air **was** still cool, and the road **was** quiet.
items.ar: وصف الخلفية بفعل was (حالة مش حدث). وصف مستمر ممكن كمان بالـ continuous.

items.en: At one point, I seriously **considered** giving up.
My legs **were aching** and my breathing **was** uneven.
items.ar: وصف إحساس مستمر في اللحظة دي.

items.en: After we **had rested** in the shade, we **continued** cycling.
items.ar: after + past perfect للأقدم، وبعده past simple.

items.en: I **didn't realise** how tired I was until I **sat** down.
When we **got** back, my mother **had** already **cooked** dinner.

blocks.title: ملحوظة عن used to
blocks.text: في أول القصة الراوي بيقول «I **used to** believe…». **used to + base** = **كنت زمان** (عادة أو فكرة في الماضي ومبقتش موجودة). ده مش واحد من التلات أزمنة، بس بيظهر كتير في الحكي.
إزاي نستخدمهم في كتابة الـ Diary

text: A good diary entry mixes the three tenses: past continuous to **set the scene**, past simple for the **main events**, and past perfect to **look back** at what happened earlier.

blocks.text: الكتاب بيطلب **diary entry من 150-180 كلمة**، والـ checklist بتاعته فيها: **narrative tenses**، كلمات الدرس، **simile** (تشبيه بـ like / as)، **contrast**، صوتك الشخصي، و**reflection** (اللي اتعلمته). شوف النموذج ده (الأزمنة bold):

blocks.title: Diary entry using narrative tenses
blocks.task: Write a diary entry about a day when you tried a new active hobby that you did not expect to enjoy. Describe what happened, how you felt and what you learned. Write about 150-180 words.
text: Today I **went** to my first pottery class at the community centre. I **had** never **touched** clay before, and I **was** sure I **would** hate it.
When I **arrived**, the other students **were** already **sitting** at their wheels. Soft music **was playing**, and the teacher **was showing** a girl how to shape a bowl. I **sat** down nervously.

At first, everything **went** wrong. The clay **kept** sliding away from my hands, and my bowl **looked** like a flat pancake. While everyone else **was smiling** at their work, I **was thinking** about leaving. But the teacher **came** over and **told** me to slow down.
By the time the class **ended**, I **had made** a small, slightly crooked cup. My hands **were** covered in clay, as grey as a rainy sky, but I **felt** strangely proud.
I **learnt** something today: leisure is not always about comfort. Sometimes the best moments come from trying again. Tomorrow I'm going back!
notes: **Opening:** Dear Diary + تحديد المشهد: رحت فين، و**past perfect** (had never touched) لحاجة قبل اليوم ده.
**الخلفية:** were sitting / was playing / was showing ← **past continuous** بيوصف المشهد لما وصلت.
**الأحداث:** arrived, sat, went wrong, came, told ← **past simple** بالترتيب.
**الـ turning point:** While everyone else was smiling, I was thinking about leaving ← past continuous زي ما الكتاب بيطلب.
**By the time … had made:** ترتيب الأحداث واضح بالـ past perfect.
**Simile:** as grey as a rainy sky.
**Contrast + Reflection:** But… ثم I learnt something today… وآخر سطر ممتع ومختصر.

blocks.title: أشهر الأخطاء (غلط ← صح)
items: ✗ By the time we got to the station, the train **has** already left. ← ✓ … the train **had** already left. (ماضي ← had)
✗ … the sun had already **rose**. ← ✓ … had already **risen**. (بعد had لازم V3)
✗ When we arrived, the shop **was** already **close**. ← ✓ … the shop **had** already **closed**.
✗ While I **cycled**, my phone **was ringing**. ← ✓ While I **was cycling**, my phone **rang**. (الطويل continuous والقصير simple)
✗ When I arrived, the film **had started** so I watched it from the beginning. ← ✓ … the film **hadn't started** yet, so I watched it from the beginning. (المعنى مهم)
✗ I **was knowing** the answer. ← ✓ I **knew** the answer. (know / like / want / believe مش بييجوا continuous)
✗ She **didn't went** to training. ← ✓ She **didn't go** to training. (بعد didn't فعل مجرد)
✗ They **was** laughing. ← ✓ They **were** laughing.

blocks.title: إزاي تجاوب بسرعة في الامتحان
items: **حدث قصير وخلص؟** past simple. **كان بيحصل في نص حاجة؟** was / were + ing.
**while** ← غالبًا past continuous. **when** + حدث قصير ← past simple.
**by the time / already / never… before** ← غالبًا **had + V3**.
لو فيه حدثين: اسأل نفسك **أنهي اللي حصل الأول؟** الأقدم ياخد had + V3.
اتأكد من **التصريف التالت** للأفعال الشاذة بعد had.

blocks.text: إزاي بييجي في الأسئلة؟
الأسئلة في الكتاب والمراجعات بتيجي بالأشكال دي. هنحل مثال لكل شكل:
**1) Only one sentence in each group is grammatically correct. Choose the correct answer.**

text: a. By the time the guests arrived, we had already decorate the hall.
b. By the time the guests arrived, we had already decorated the hall.
c. By the time the guests arrived, we have already decorated the hall.
d. By the time the guests arrived, we were already decorated the hall.

blocks.text: **الإجابة: b.** ليه؟ by the time + past simple ← had + V3 (decorated). (a) decorate مش V3. (c) have للحاضر. (d) were decorated معناها «احنا اتزيّنا»!
**2) Complete with the correct form of the verb in brackets.**

text: While Hany (practise) ______ the piano, the lights suddenly (go) ______ out.

blocks.text: **الإجابة:** was practising / went. ليه؟ while + حدث طويل ← past continuous، والحدث القصير اللي قطعه ← past simple.
**3) Read and answer: Find a sentence that shows something happened before another past action.**

text: When Laila reached the stadium, her team had already scored two goals. She was disappointed, but she cheered loudly until the end.

blocks.text: **الإجابة:** «her team **had already scored** two goals» ← الأهداف حصلت **قبل** ما توصل، والدليل had + V3 وكلمة already.
تدريب
**A. Choose the correct answer from a, b, c or d.**

items.q:
1. I ______ along the river when I saw an old friend.
a. walked  b. was walking  c. had walked  d. walk
items.a: **b. was walking** — حدث طويل اتقطع بحدث قصير (saw).

items.q:
2. By the time we got to the cinema, the film ______.
a. already started  b. has already started  c. had already started  d. was already start
items.a: **c. had already started** — by the time ← past perfect.

items.q:
3. While the musicians ______, the lights suddenly went out.
a. played  b. were playing  c. had played  d. play
items.a: **b. were playing** — while + حدث طويل كان مستمر، والحدث القصير اللي قطعه (went out) past simple.

items.q:
4. Yesterday, Mazen ______ his first marathon.
a. was running  b. had run  c. ran  d. runs
items.a: **c. ran** — yesterday + حدث كامل خلص ← past simple.

items.q:
5. She ______ never ______ a horse before she visited the farm.
a. has / ridden  b. had / ridden  c. had / rode  d. was / riding
items.a: **b. had / ridden** — never … before + حدث في الماضي ← had + V3 (ride → rode → ridden).

items.q:
6. When I opened the window, it ______ heavily, so I quickly closed it again.
a. rained  b. had rained  c. was raining  d. rains
items.a: **c. was raining** — المطر كان **شغال** لما فتحت الشباك (خلفية).

items.q:
7. After he ______ his homework, Ahmed went out to play football.
a. had finished  b. has finished  c. was finishing  d. finishes
items.a: **a. had finished** — after + الحدث الأقدم ← had + V3.

items.q:
8. We ______ to the beach because the weather was terrible.
a. didn't went  b. weren't go  c. didn't go  d. hadn't went
items.a: **c. didn't go** — didn't + base.

blocks.text: **B. Only one sentence in each group is grammatically correct. Choose the correct answer.**

items.q:
9. a. While I was painting, my little brother was watching me.
b. While I painted, my little brother watching me.
c. While I was paint, my little brother was watching me.
d. While I painting, my little brother watched me.
items.a: **a** — حدثين طوال في نفس الوقت، والاتنين was + ing.

items.q:
10. a. When we arrived, the match has finished.
b. When we arrived, the match had finish.
c. When we arrived, the match had finished.
d. When we arrived, the match was finish.
items.a: **c** — الماتش خلص قبل ما نوصل ← had + V3.

items.q:
11. a. They was training when the storm started.
b. They were training when the storm started.
c. They were training when the storm was start.
d. They trained when the storm had starting.
items.a: **b** — they ← were، والحدث القصير started (past simple).

items.q:
12. a. I had never swam in the sea before that summer.
b. I had never swim in the sea before that summer.
c. I had never swum in the sea before that summer.
d. I have never swum in the sea before that summer.
items.a: **c** — swim → swam → **swum**، و before that summer (ماضي) ← had.

blocks.text: **C. Complete the story with the correct form of the verbs in brackets.**

items.q: 13. Last Friday, my cousin and I (decide) ______ to climb a small hill near Fayoum.
items.a: **decided** — حدث كامل في الماضي (Last Friday).

items.q: 14. When we started, the sun (shine) ______ and a light wind (blow) ______.
items.a: **was shining / was blowing** — وصف الخلفية لما بدأنا.

items.q: 15. I (never / climb) ______ a hill before, so I was a bit nervous.
items.a: **had never climbed** — never … before في قصة ماضية ← past perfect.

items.q: 16. Halfway up, while we (rest) ______ on a rock, my cousin (drop) ______ his water bottle.
items.a: **were resting / dropped** — حدث طويل + حدث قصير قطعه.

items.q: 17. By the time we (reach) ______ the top, we (drink) ______ all our water.
items.a: **reached / had drunk** — by the time + past simple، والحدث الأقدم had + V3 (drink → drank → drunk).

items.q: 18. We (sit) ______ down, (look) ______ at the view and (laugh) ______ at how tired we were.
items.a: **sat / looked / laughed** — أحداث ورا بعض بالترتيب ← past simple.

blocks.text: **D. Join, correct and write as asked.**

items.q: 19. Join with 'when': Mariam was reading in the garden. Her phone rang.
items.a: Mariam **was reading** in the garden **when** her phone **rang**. — الطويل continuous والقصير simple.

items.q: 20. Join with 'by the time': The guests arrived. We prepared the food before that.
items.a: **By the time** the guests **arrived**, we **had prepared** the food. — التحضير حصل الأول.

items.q: 21. Find and correct the mistake: While I cycled home, I was seeing a beautiful sunset.
items.a: While I **was cycling** home, I **saw** a beautiful sunset. — الطويل continuous، و see فعل مش بييجي continuous بمعنى «شاف».

items.q: 22. Find and correct the mistake: I realised that I left my keys at the gym.
items.a: I realised that I **had left** my keys at the gym. — نسيان المفاتيح حصل **قبل** ما أدرك.

items.q: 23. Write the opening of a diary entry (2 sentences) using the past continuous to set the scene.
items.a: مثال: Dear Diary, This afternoon the streets **were** busy and people **were rushing** home. I **was waiting** at the bus stop with my football boots in my bag. — وصف المشهد بالـ continuous.

items.q: 24. Write ONE sentence about a time you finished something difficult. Use the past perfect and the past simple.
items.a: مثال: When I finally **crossed** the finish line, I **had run** five kilometres for the first time in my life. — الجري حصل قبل لحظة الوصول.

blocks.title: ملخص الدرس في سطرين
items: **Past simple** = الأحداث الأساسية بالترتيب (V2 / didn't + base).
**Past continuous** = الخلفية، وحدث طويل اتقطع، وحدثين مع بعض بـ while (was / were + ing).
**Past perfect** = حاجة حصلت **قبل** حدث تاني في الماضي (had + V3)، مع by the time / already / never… before.
**when** + حدث قصير، **while** + حدث طويل. والأفعال زي know / like / believe مش بتيجي continuous.
في الـ diary: continuous للمشهد، simple للأحداث، perfect للفلاش باك، وفي الآخر reflection.
